text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Morocco launches reforms to improve stock market performance. Story refers to decision to set up a second market for trading small companies and a central depository body for more transparent trading.
- The United States hails Morocco's leading role in fisheries in North Africa and calls for cooperation for rational management of stocks.
- Farmers worried about effects of bad weather on crops.
- Gross domestic product expected to increase by 3.0 percent this year but persistent unemployment and insufficient investments delay economic development.

- Promising year for investment with a convention signed between banks and the finance ministry to boost investment. Banks plan to reduce interest rates on loans for small and medium-sized firms. Stock exchange reforms also planned.
